evals.prompt: I need images for my Call of Cthulhu one-shot set in a 1920s Ligurian fishing village. Scenes: 1) the village seen from an arriving boat at dusk, fog rolling in; 2) the abandoned lighthouse interior, keeper's dinner still on the table covered in mold; 3) portrait of Don Ruggero, the village priest hiding a terrible secret, gaunt, always clutching his rosary. Give me Midjourney prompts.
evals.expected_output: Three ready-to-paste English MJ prompts with consistent 1920s horror style block, correct params (--ar, --exp), shot types stated, no junk tokens like '8k masterpiece'

evals.prompt: Mi servono le musiche per la sessione di stasera di Vileborn: 1) tema di esplorazione per le catacombe sotto la cattedrale, 2) traccia di combattimento per lo scontro con l'Angelo Caduto (boss finale), 3) qualcosa di malinconico per il funerale del PNG amico dei PG. Dammi i prompt per Suno.
evals.expected_output: Three Suno cues: English style prompts (4-7 descriptors, gothic grimdark palette), lyrics-field blocks with meta tags ending in [End], instrumental settings + slider advice, table usage notes

evals.prompt: Devo preparare la sessione di sabato per la mia campagna di Symbaroum. I PG (una strega, un cacciatore di taglie e uno studioso di Ordo Magica) hanno appena scoperto che un villaggio ai margini del Davokar è stato abbandonato in una notte. Scrivi l'avventura completa per una sessione di 4 ore.
evals.expected_output: Italian table-ready document following references/modello.md: opens with 'La vicenda in breve', a 300-600 word prose synopsis in five bold-labelled blocks, then at-a-glance table, dramatic question, 3-5 revelations each with at least three clues across at least two scenes, clock of 4-6 steps ending in 'Se nessuno interviene', world truths, strong start as a > read-aloud block with senses only, scene map, 4-6 scenes each with 'Da non perdere qui', 'Cosa succede da sé', 'Chi c'è' with a line per NPC, 'Indizi qui', 'Se i PG… | Allora…' table and 'Se deragliano', clue tracker table, NPC table with name bank, visual:/mood: only in the closing appendix. No sentence where a PC is the subject of an action, decision or emotion. No em or en dashes. Symbaroum stats marked [da manuale] rather than invented. Every scene, including the climax, opens with a short > read-aloud block; 'Indizi qui' writes each clue in full ('- **I4.** text (R1)'), not just its ID; every bold field is its own paragraph with a blank line before it. python3 plugins/rpg-prep/skills/enhanced-avventure-rpg/scripts/controlla.py <output> exits 0.

evals.prompt: Sistema questa avventura per il tavolo: durante la sessione non trovo niente. Non cambiare i contenuti.
evals.expected_output: Same content as the input restructured into the template, comparable to references/esempio.md: a 'La vicenda in breve' synopsis (300-600 words, five blocks) opens the document, plus an 'Antefatto' section if the input explains why the PCs are there; the ten secrets regrouped into 3-5 revelations with clue IDs; 'Se i giocatori ignorano l'esca' moved into the clock's last step; Occasioni di Dissonanza moved into each scene's 'Da non perdere qui'; PG secrets surfaced in the scenes they touch; stat blocks and pregenerati under 'Schede'; 'Tempi indicativi' in the header; Scene 5 written as a full scene instead of 'Vedi Climax flessibile'; every visual:/mood: moved to the appendix. No invented facts beyond NPC lines flagged as additions. Golden-rule violations in the input reported separately, not silently rewritten. Every scene, including the climax, opens with a short > read-aloud block; 'Indizi qui' writes each clue in full ('- **I4.** text (R1)'), not just its ID; every bold field is its own paragraph with a blank line before it. python3 plugins/rpg-prep/skills/enhanced-avventure-rpg/scripts/controlla.py <output> exits 0.

evals.prompt: Voglio iniziare una campagna di Symbaroum di circa un anno, una sessione ogni due settimane, con quattro giocatori. Tema: la corruzione che si paga per proteggere chi si ama. Progettala.
evals.expected_output: Joplin note titled «Campagna: <nome>» following references/modello.md: header with Sessioni about 20-26 and Arco corrente; premise and open campaign question; 5-8 world truths starting with the pressure already under way; 2-4 fronts each with Obiettivo, Volto with a line, why hard to stop, a clock of 3-6 steps ending in «Se vince»; faction table; one block per PC with desire, fear, secret, bond, open question, fronts and arcs; 2-5 arcs written as functions with session ranges, question, fronts, revelations, PCs at the centre, tone shift and first cut; 2-4 endings as world states with conditions and seeds placed in earlier arcs; thread tracker; themes; 5 C's check; session zero; Aggiornamenti; visual/mood only in the appendix. No sentence predicts what a PC will do. No em or en dashes. Every bold field has a blank line before it. python3 plugins/rpg-prep/skills/campagna-rpg/scripts/controlla.py <output> exits 0.

evals.prompt: Aggiorna la campagna: nelle ultime due sessioni i PG hanno trovato il registro delle maree della Confraternita e hanno fatto saltare un dragone del Consorzio. Nane ha deciso di vendere la casa.
evals.expected_output: Starting from references/esempio.md as the current note: F1 clock does not advance or moves back for the destroyed dredger; T6 marked ripagato; a new thread for Nane's sale; A1 closed and A2 in corso if its function is met; Arco corrente updated; the next arc reshaped rather than forcing the PCs back onto the plan; a summary of changes shown before overwriting; a dated entry in Aggiornamenti listing the sessions read. Past PC actions are recorded as facts; nothing predicts future PC choices. python3 plugins/rpg-prep/skills/campagna-rpg/scripts/controlla.py <output> exits 0.

evals.prompt: Rivedi questa avventura: la logica regge? La storia scorre? Fai l'avvocato del diavolo.
evals.expected_output: Report in the chat only, no file or note, following references/rapporto.md: what was read, a one-sentence verdict, problems numbered P1… ordered by severity (bloccante, serio, minore), each with location IDs (S, R, I or quoted text), what goes wrong at the table, root cause and a fix at the root; a «Da chiarire» list; «Controlli superati». Expected to surface at least: the missing rule for destroying the Anchor (S5), the timing of Donato's arrival versus the second quake, and the question of «La Maestà» stopping non-Awakened PCs. No invented problems that the document already resolves (e.g. clue counts, scene reachability). Does not rewrite the document. Ends by opening the brainstorm with one question about the most serious problem. Italian, no em or en dashes.

evals.prompt: Metti alla prova questa campagna: fronti, archi e finali reggono?
evals.expected_output: Campaign attacks from references/attacchi-campagna.md applied to the note: front clocks causal and paced, why fronts do not win at once, arcs that depend on a specific PC choice, endings reachable two ways and seeded earlier, every PC centred and touched by a front, threads payable. Simulated tables run on arcs. Report in the chat in the rapporto.md format with P-numbered findings and severity, verified against the note; then one brainstorm question. Italian, no em or en dashes.

evals.prompt: Impagina questa avventura in PDF, la voglio stampare per sabato.
evals.expected_output: Works on a copy: HTML comments removed and '# L'Ancora di Sabaoth' as the first line. Lists the ## sections and says only the appendix stays out of the PDF. Checks python3 -c 'import weasyprint, markdown_it' and, if it fails, uses a venv, asks before installing Pango, or falls back to Docker. Runs scripts/impagina.py and writes the PDF next to the source. Looks at the PDF: title in the cover and footer, no raw <!-- or ** text, one page per scene S1-S5 with its tab lit, threat boxes for Il Circolo dello Stretto, Tenente Donato, Pattuglia di Quieti and Dottor Umberto Salvi. Does not rewrite the adventure text. Reply in Italian, no em or en dashes.
